collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GL Class 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz GL Class SUV 2012 Onwards (X166) requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 23" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this GL Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
